remarks: Easy condo living in sought after Middlesex Commons. This spacious home has two bedrooms and two and a half baths. Enter into a sun-filled foyer that leads to a bright eat-in kitchen. The open dining and living rooms, with a soaring ceiling, open out to a generous deck with plenty of room for dining al fresco or lounging in the sun. Upstairs you will find two en-suite bedrooms with high ceilings and plenty of natural light. The condo comes with a detached one car garage and a separate large storage area. The complex has a swimming pool and pool house, and a guest cottage that can be rented for visiting family members and friends. Located in the heart of Darien, near the shops and train, this is easy living at its best!
